articles.summary: READING, PENNSYLVANIA — March 23, 2026 — EnerSys (NYSE: ENS), a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications, has surpassed 4 million Hawker® ARMASAFE™ Plus 6TAGM batteries sold worldwide. Engineered with proprietary Absorbed Glass Mat (AGM) Thin Plate Pure Lead (TPPL) technology, the maintenance-free battery delivers higher starting power, long service life, deep cycle capability, and superior reliability across demanding industrial and military applications. EnerSys will celebrate the innovation behind this state-of-the-art battery solution at the 2026 AUSA Global Force Symposium & Exposition in booth #722 starting Tuesday, March 24, 2026.
articles.title: EnerSys Surpasses 4 Million Hawker® ARMASAFE™ Plus 6TAGM Batteries Sold Worldwide, Marking Two Decades of Proven Field Performance
